basis: Repository owner explicitly selected the thesis filtered selection as the final public result.

previous_output.disposition: Preserved unchanged as the historical v3.10 hand-off; superseded for the final thesis selection.
previous_output.rule: Unfiltered Tier 1 ranks 1-50; shuffle and Tier 2 were annotations only.

scientific_boundary: Computational prioritisation only. No candidate is advanced to experimental validation, and no binding, affinity, inhibition or target recognition is demonstrated.
selection_rule: Use the 1,000 candidates with exact Tier 2 results from the closed 30,000-member D1 run.
Require shuffle == pass and compatibility in {strong, moderate}.
Order by ascending frozen Tier 1 rank, then ascending opaque candidate ID.
Retain the first 50 without manual reordering.
